name: Macronix International Co., Ltd.
blurb: Macronix International Co., Ltd. (TWSE: 2337) is a Taiwan-based integrated device manufacturer (IDM — a company that both designs and fabricates its own chips) specialising in NOR flash memory and mask ROM. NOR flash is the non-volatile memory used for code storage and boot firmware in microcontrollers, automotive systems, IoT devices, and industrial equipment; unlike NAND flash, it allows random-access byte-level reads, making it essential where firmware must execute directly from storage. Macronix is one of the few remaining independent NOR flash IDMs globally.
recent: Macronix reported FY2025 revenue of NT$28.9 billion, up 11.6% year-over-year, driven by recovering demand in automotive and industrial end markets. In 2025 the company introduced ArmorBoot MX76, a secure-boot NOR flash combining rapid boot performance with integrated security features, targeting embedded and automotive applications. The stock reached an all-time high of NT$170 in March 2026.
